subject: Delete unused parts of zipmap (#973)
reason: The change only deletes zipmap functions that nothing in the server references (zipmapNew/Set/Del/Get/Exists/Len/BlobLen and their static helpers) and rewrites the unit tests to use hand-built byte literals instead of the deleted writers. The sole runtime user of zipmap is rdb.c's loading of legacy zipmap-encoded hashes (RDB_TYPE_HASH_ZIPMAP), which calls only zipmapValidateIntegrity, zipmapRewind and zipmapNext — all left byte-for-byte unchanged (zipmapGetEncodedLengthSize was merely relocated).
